changelog: Adding a device to an account that has none works. The call that creates the first station was sending it in the wrong shape, which the server refused — and every brand-new account makes exactly that call for its first device.
The device's serial number now comes from the device. The app was making one up and declaring it virtual, which a collector that has already detected its inverter rejects.
"Device already linked" is now decided by asking the device, not by reading words out of an error message.
